summary: Verified the NodeHost read chain that carries the retained ReadIndex defect to a client and recorded it as a behavior entry. SyncRead calls linearizableRead with a Lookup callback; linearizableRead requires a caller-supplied timeout, calls nh.readIndex, which calls node.read with getTimeoutTick(timeout) before marking the engine step ready; node.read rejects an uninitialized node with ErrClusterNotReady and a witness with ErrInvalidOperation and otherwise registers through pendingReadIndexes.read; linearizableRead waits on getRequestState before running the callback, and NodeHost.ReadIndex resolves the same helper. This records that the affected wait is bounded by the caller deadline and that a witness cannot reach the pending batch. Added two new source ranges and reused the existing linearizableRead and node.read excerpts. Validation reports valid, no_change false, execution_requested false, with two source creates and one knowledge create. No execution was run.
